hit_rows.value: the fermented roe of the silt-carp
hit_rows.answer: The signature tang is said to come from a spoonful of fermented fen-samphire (marsh glasswort) stirred in just before serving, but that link survives only in 20th-century Findrup cookbooks and oral lore.
